rules.statement: A party who was not a party to the partition action is not bound by the interlocutory decree if lis pendens had not been properly registered, but does not have the right to intervene and set aside the interlocutory decree.
rules.supporting_quote: "That is all that sub-Section 3 provides. A person who was not a party to the partition action is not bound by the interlocutory decree if lis pendens had not been properly registered. This does not mean that he is entitled to intervene and have the interlocutory decree set aside."
